info.name: Leave Management System API
info.description:
Comprehensive API documentation for the Employee Leave Management System.

## Base URL
`http://localhost:5000/api`

## Authentication
All protected endpoints require a Bearer token in the Authorization header:
```
Authorization: Bearer <your_jwt_token>
```

The token is obtained from the `/auth/login` endpoint.

## Roles
- **EMPLOYEE** - Can apply, view, update, and cancel their own leave requests
- **MANAGER** - Can view team leaves and approve/reject them

## Response Format
All responses follow this structure:
```json
{
  "success": true | false,
  "message": "Human-readable message",
  "data": { ... } | null
}
```

request.description:
Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token along with user details.

**No authentication required.**

### Request Body
| Field    | Type   | Required | Description            |
|----------|--------|----------|------------------------|
| email    | string | ✅       | Registered email address |
| password | string | ✅       | Account password       |

### Success Response (200)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Login successful",
  "data": {
    "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
    "user": {
      "id": 2,
      "employeeCode": "EMP001",
      "name": "Employee One",
      "email": "employee1@gmail.com",
      "department": "IT",
      "role": "EMPLOYEE"
    }
  }
}
```

### Error Responses
| Status | Reason                          |
|--------|---------------------------------|
| 400    | Missing or invalid fields       |
| 401    | Incorrect email or password     |
| 500    | Internal server error           |

| role       | string | ❌       | Filter by role (EMPLOYEE/MANAGER) |

item.name: Leave (Employee)
item.description: Leave management endpoints for employees. All require EMPLOYEE role.

request.description:
Submit a new leave request. The leave is created with `PENDING` status.

**Authentication required. Role: EMPLOYEE**

### Request Body
| Field     | Type   | Required | Description                              |
|-----------|--------|----------|------------------------------------------|
| leaveType | enum   | ✅       | CASUAL \| SICK \| EARNED \| WFH         |
| startDate | string | ✅       | Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format          |
| endDate   | string | ✅       | End date in YYYY-MM-DD format            |
| reason    | string | ✅       | Reason for the leave request             |

**Authentication required. Role: EMPLOYEE**

|-----------|---------|----------|-------------------|
| id        | integer | ✅       | Leave Request ID  |

{

    "totalEmployees": 2,
    "pendingApprovals": 3,

**Authentication required. Role: MANAGER**

| Parameter | Type    | Required | Description       |
|-----------|---------|----------|-------------------|
| id        | integer | ✅       | Leave Request ID  |

No body required.

**Authentication required. Role: MANAGER**

| Parameter | Type    | Required | Description       |
|-----------|---------|----------|-------------------|
| id        | integer | ✅       | Leave Request ID  |

### Request Body
| Field           | Type   | Required | Description                   |
|-----------------|--------|----------|-------------------------------|
| managerComments | string | ❌       | Reason for rejection          |
